item.title: How to Set Up a Tor Hidden Service
item.description:
What is Tor?

Tor is a free overlay network that enables anonymous communication.
It is built on free and open-source software and run by over seven thousand volunteer-operated relays worldwide, as well as by millions of users who route their internet traffic through random paths across these relays.
This technique is called onion routing.

Installing Tor

First, we need to install the Tor service on our server.
This guide uses a Debian-based distribution.
